-1.event_info: Initial trigger for miner action submission

1.event_info: Action bundle received for validation and budget clipping

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the agent submitting the action bundle

fields.name: action_bundle
fields.description: JSON object containing claims, raids, defense commitments, and mining allocations

fields.name: stamina_budget
fields.description: Agent's stamina budget for the current round

2.event_info: Action bundle passes legality checks and budget clipping

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the agent whose bundle was validated

fields.name: validated_actions
fields.description: Action bundle after legality checks and budget clipping

fields.name: stamina_used
fields.description: Total stamina consumed by validated actions

fields.name: illegal_actions
fields.description: List of illegal actions removed from the bundle

3.event_info: Unowned plots have been claimed via deterministic hash-based tie-breaking

fields.name: claimed_plots
fields.description: List of unowned plots with resolved ownership

fields.name: tie_breaker_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 hash used for deterministic tie-breaking

4.event_info: Raid outcomes determined with defense commitments applied

fields.name: raided_plots
fields.description: List of plots with raid outcomes and involved agents

fields.name: stamina_used_raids
fields.description: Total stamina consumed by raid actions

5.event_info: Mining output calculated based on post-conflict ownership and stamina allocation

fields.name: plot_row
fields.description: Row index of the plot being mined

fields.name: plot_col
fields.description: Column index of the plot being mined

fields.name: owner_id
fields.description: Agent ID of the post-conflict plot owner

fields.name: stamina_allocated
fields.description: Stamina allocated to mining by the owner

fields.name: gold_mined
fields.description: Gold extracted from the plot (min(stamina_allocated, s_max))
